afe.review:
AFE is the GOAT
. AFE sir ei course na nile pura mara khaitam.
This course requires significant improvements, and at least CSE445/CSE465 should be a prerequisite for it.
Cons:
1. The most unorganized course I have ever done.
2. Faculty seems to have no idea what students are learning.
3. If someone has no previous experience in machine learning or neural networks, this course will be hell for them.
4. The course only taught us CNN/ViT/Autoencoders/RCNN. Despite the low course content, many students were struggling.
Pros:
1. AFE sir

vai keo CSE445, CSE465 na kore ei faculty niyen na, easygoing vebe grade er chintay ashle msrb nen ...VLM niye youtube a temon valo resource o nai, ar sir er paper gula dekheo bujha jay onk knowledge ase onr..othocho kicho student er jonne just ViT porjonto cover korte pare.. ekjon comment korlo "Faculty seems to have no idea what students are learning." ! eita true, ekhon keo jodi 445, 465 na kore ashe tare kivabe ViT theke shekhano shuru korbe..ei course er main content gulai ashar kotha vision transformer er por theke.. sir semester er shuru tei rag, vision rag, clip eshob niye ekta overview dey jate shobai project shuru korte pare, ekhon je 445 e kore nai tar mathay eshob kivabe dhukbe! 465 a to ontoto transformers porjonto poray fele

Would say 468 if nsu put a prerequisite of doing 465 before enrolling in this course
But if AFE sir takes 468 again in the next semester taile you can do it as you will also learn about research papers a lot
As for the theory, since I'm still in the middle of doing this course so would be able to give a better review after this semester ends

I'd recommend not taking AFE. He is a changed person since last semester. It seems like he only comes to the class to cater students who have prior research experience or solid understanding of topics that he didn't even teach. He openly humiliates you in each project update to the point where you would want to drop the course midway. He'll give a feedback and in the next update he'll deny what he said previously. Didn't curve as well. Overall a very bad experience.

When I did a course in the last sem, felt like sir is being strict or rude in order to force us to learn so I kinda accepted it. But this sem it felt like he doesn't care if I learn or do any good, he's just having fun humiliating anyone at the slightest inconvenience.

He doesn't specify which domain the projects should be from. He mentions some conferences and expects that students will find their own project ideas. In our section, he didn't brag that much about the project ideas. But after the updates start, for most groups he couldn't guide throughout the project properly at all. Each week he will tell different things that it might feel like you have completely lost the path of what you started at the beginning.
